name: UXD Widgets for Elementor
author: UX Design Experts

sections.description:
UXD Widgets for Elementor adds the two things Elementor Free leaves out: a complete Theme Builder for custom headers, footers, and archive templates, and 25+ production-ready widgets for the pages in between.

No licence key, no feature locked behind an upgrade prompt, and no Elementor Pro required.

Free Theme Builder

Design your whole site in Elementor instead of only the page content. Create a template, build it visually, choose where it appears, and UXD takes over that part of your theme.

  • Header — a real site-wide header built entirely in Elementor
  • Footer — a matching site-wide footer
  • Single Post and Single Page — custom layouts for your content
  • Blog Page — design the posts index
  • Archive — category, tag, author, and date archives
  • Search Results — a designed results page instead of the theme default
  • 404 Page — a branded not-found page

Display conditions control where each template applies: the entire site, all singular content, all archives, the blog page, search results, the 404 page, or a specific list of post or page IDs. Templates render on Elementor’s canvas template, so your theme’s markup never fights your design.

Any template can be switched on or off from UXD Widgets → Theme Builder without deleting it, so you can try a new header and roll back in one click.

Theme Builder Widgets

Dynamic widgets that pull real content into the templates above:

  • Post Title, Post Content, Post Featured Image, Post Meta
  • Archive Title, Posts Loop, Pagination
  • Search Form, Search Query, Search Results
  • WooCommerce — Product Title, Price, Images, Add to Cart, Description, and Meta (registered only when WooCommerce is active)

25+ Free Widgets

A clean, production-ready set for building fast, conversion-focused pages — every one fully functional with no licence required.

  • Nav Menu — sticky navigation with dropdown, off-canvas flyout, and full-screen mobile menus
  • Icon List — icon/number/none prefix list with horizontal and vertical layouts, plus per-item background, padding, border, and box-shadow controls
  • Hero Eyebrow — pill + label eyebrow component styled out of the box for above-heading labels
  • Hero Trust — avatar stack, star rating, and trust copy for social proof sections
  • Stats Counter — animated number counters with icons, prefix/suffix support, and optional grid mode
  • Countdown Timer — date-based and evergreen countdowns with flip and block styles
  • Testimonial — testimonial card with avatar, rating, quote, author, and company fields
  • Highlight Heading — animated highlighted text with underline, background, wavy, and marker styles
  • Progress Bar — animated horizontal or circular progress indicators
  • Blockquote — styled pull quote with author attribution
  • Business Hours — day/time repeater with open/closed highlight
  • Accordion & FAQ Accordion — standard and schema-ready accordion widgets
  • Alert Box — dismissible alert banners with icon and custom colors
  • Breadcrumb — automatic breadcrumb trail with full styling control
  • Scroll to Top — smooth-scroll button with position, offset, and animation controls
  • Social Icons — icon-only or icon+label links to social profiles
  • Logo Carousel — Swiper-powered partner/client logo slider with autoplay
  • Blog Posts — query-based post grid with thumbnail, excerpt, and meta
  • Simple List — shared-icon list with 10 hover animation styles
  • Feature Box — icon/image card widget with hover animations
  • Button & Dual Button — styled CTA buttons with icon support
  • Divider — styleable horizontal rules with icon and text options
  • Logo — site logo widget for headers

Widgets Manager

Every widget has an on/off switch under UXD Widgets → Widgets Manager. Disabled widgets are never loaded at all — no CSS, no JavaScript, no clutter in the Elementor panel — so the editor stays fast on sites that only need a handful.

Why UXD Widgets

  • Works with Elementor Free — the theme builder and every widget, no Pro licence
  • No upsells in the editor — nothing is greyed out or locked
  • Theme-agnostic — works with Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Blocksy, and any other theme
  • Loads only what you use — per-widget toggles and per-widget stylesheets
  • No external services — all CSS and JavaScript is bundled locally

External Services

This plugin does not connect to any external services. All assets (CSS and JavaScript) are bundled locally within the plugin.

Support

For support, please visit: https://uxdesignexperts.com/support

Credits

  • Swiper – https://swiperjs.com/
  • Developed by UX Design Experts – https://uxdesignexperts.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the uxd-widgets-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install it from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Ensure Elementor (free) is installed and active.
  4. Go to UXD Widgets → Theme Builder to create your header, footer, and other templates.
  5. Go to UXD Widgets → Widgets Manager to enable or disable individual widgets.
  6. Open any page in the Elementor editor — all active UXD widgets appear under the UXD Widgets panel category.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro?

No. The Theme Builder and all 25+ widgets work with Elementor Free. Elementor Pro is not required for any feature.

How do I build a custom header and footer?

Go to UXD Widgets → Theme Builder, create a Header template, and build it in Elementor like any other page. Set its display conditions (Entire Site for a normal header), mark it active, and it replaces your theme’s header. Footers work the same way.

Does the Theme Builder replace Elementor Pro’s theme builder?

Yes, for most use cases. UXD Theme Builder covers header, footer, single post, single page, blog page, archive, search results, and 404 templates, with display conditions for each.

Will it conflict with my theme’s header and footer?

No. When a template is active, UXD replaces the theme’s header or footer output rather than rendering both. If you deactivate the template, your theme’s original header returns immediately.

Can I disable widgets I don’t need?

Yes. Go to UXD Widgets → Widgets Manager and toggle any widget on or off. Disabled widgets are not loaded at all, keeping your site lean.

Is WooCommerce required?

No. WooCommerce widgets are registered only when WooCommerce is active. Everything else works independently.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes. UXD Widgets for Elementor is theme-agnostic and works with Hello Elementor, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Blocksy, and any other WordPress theme.

How do I get support?

Visit https://uxdesignexperts.com/support to open a support request.
